cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && set -o pipefail && test -s bench/results/environment-narration/t9h-drain/smoke/off/rows/summary.json && test -s bench/results/environment-narration/t9h-drain/smoke/off/rows/rows.json && test -s bench/results/environment-narration/t9h-drain/smoke/spent.json && (set -a; . ./.env; set +a; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY2'
import json,os,pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('bench/results/environment-narration/t9h-drain/smoke')
text=''.join(p.read_text(errors='ignore') for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.json','.log'))
for n in ('CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN','CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID','CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN','OPENAI_API_KEY','RAILWAY_TOKEN'):
    v=os.environ.get(n,'').strip()
    assert not v or v not in text, n+' leaked'
off=json.load(open(base/'off/rows/summary.json'))
assert 'stopped_reason' in off
on=base/'on/rows/summary.json'
if off['stopped_reason'] is None:
    assert on.exists(), 'ON arm missing although OFF finished'
    s=json.load(open(on)); assert s.get('scene_state') is True, 'ON arm did not run with scene_state'
    rows=json.load(open(base/'on/rows/rows.json'))
    atts=[a for r in rows for t in r.get('turns',[]) for a in t.get('enforce_attempts',[])]
    assert all('scene_state' in a for a in atts),'attempt without scene_state record'
print('integrity ok')
PY2
)
